create_flowers_dataset_train: create a Flowers dataset instance in training mode with optional transforms for Oxford 102 flowers
create_flowers_dataset_test: create a Flowers dataset instance in test mode using the test split from setid.mat
get_flowers_item: get an image and its label by index from the Flowers dataset using __getitem__
get_flowers_length: get the total number of images in the Flowers dataset using __len__
review_flowers_class: review the Flowers VisionDataset subclass that loads Oxford 102 flowers from MATLAB files
